entries.title: Clinical Documentation Standards
entries.content:
# Clinical Documentation Standards

## SOAP Note Format
- **Subjective**: Patient's reported symptoms and concerns
- **Objective**: Measurable findings (vitals, exam results)
- **Assessment**: Clinical interpretation and diagnosis
- **Plan**: Treatment plan and follow-up

## Documentation Principles
1. Accuracy: Record exactly what was observed/reported
2. Timeliness: Document as close to the event as possible
3. Completeness: Include all relevant information
4. Legibility: Clear and readable entries

entries.title: ICD-10 Terminology Guidelines
entries.content:
# ICD-10 Coding Guidelines

## Basic Principles
- Use the most specific code available
- Code to the highest level of specificity
- Do not code suspected conditions as confirmed

## Common Categories
- A00-B99: Infectious diseases
- C00-D49: Neoplasms
- E00-E89: Endocrine and metabolic diseases
- I00-I99: Diseases of the circulatory system
- M00-M99: Diseases of the musculoskeletal system

entries.title: HIPAA Privacy Guidelines
entries.content:
# HIPAA Privacy Guidelines

## Protected Health Information (PHI)
- Patient names
- Dates (birth, admission, discharge)
- Geographic data (address, zip code)
- Phone/fax numbers
- Email addresses
- Social Security numbers
- Medical record numbers

## Documentation Requirements
1. Minimum necessary standard
2. Patient consent for disclosure
3. Audit trail for access
4. Secure storage and transmission
